title: Having issues trying to change the font with RM2K3 on Steam

posts.author: cuebitcrush
posts.body:
I am able to change the font but I don't think I'm doing it properly because no matter what, the font I import has an extra outline and looks really bad.
I heard that the Steam version of 2K3 required a different process so I've tried a few things (following an old set of instructions by Cherry using Resource Hacker and Hyper Patcher 2, changing the hex code, renaming the font and importing it using Resource Hacker) but none of them have worked. I thought that maybe the fonts I downloaded didn't have the right size for the software so I even tried editing the default font and exporting that to use, but the same thing happened.
I would really appreciate it if anyone could give me a hand with this.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I did the entire process explained in your post on Reddit and it worked.
Your error is probably when changing the font name in properties through
Fony
.

So try to make a video of the whole process, maybe then I can analyze which part of the process you are doing wrong.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
The result in this image you posted on Reddit is only when the FONT is not found by
RPG_RT.exe
...
If the fonts are looking exactly like this I'm sad to inform you, but you're still getting something wrong.
I asked for the video for an obvious reason, the lack of information about the "step by step" you used, without something "visual" no one will guess with these explanations, even if you repost it in another community. You will go around and around the same suggestions and end up in the same alley of uncertainty about where you are going wrong.
Depending on what you do, I wish you good luck.

posts.author: cuebitcrush
posts.body:
Sorry if I'm not explaining well. I'm certain that I entered the names correctly. I followed Cherry's guide to a T and it was mentioned there to make sure you did, so I went to the properties tab in Fony and changed the font header that way.
It is working now after I manually edited the font that I was using and tried following Cherry's tutorial again. It turns out that Fony keeps resizing my fonts and making them bolder, but I couldn't tell before because I had been using the older version of Fony and it didn't give me a preview. The font I was trying to use in the screenshot you've attached just did not work because Fony made it the completely wrong size. That's my fault it wasn't clear because that's the screenshot you've been operating with.
